dimension_description: Electric current measures how quickly charge moves through a circuit or plasma. Some entries here are direct device ratings, while others are derived from one charge carrier crossing in a stated time or from power and voltage using I = P / V. This lets the scale connect single-ion channels, USB power delivery, household wiring, industrial systems, and lightning.
